authorization: implementation and synthetic tests only; real discovery execution is forbidden until a later governance release

threat_model.guarantee: logical row admission: no source row at or after a case clock may be passed to the causal reader or observer before every selected case sharing that clock is committed
threat_model.review_guarantee: selection and Pass2 bind their original absolute engine root; reviewer export is random-rekeyed outside that root and exposes no event-specific commitment, while an engine-only mapping binds every reviewer unit to the exact registered Pass2 commitment
threat_model.not_claimed: Parquet and operating-system readers may decode or cache bytes from a row group containing later rows; this runner does not claim byte-level physical isolation
threat_model.trusted_boundary: the runner derives provenance, row hashes, rolling roots, reset provenance and context-complete case eligibility internally

source_iterator.checkpoint_boundary: after a complete real source bar, and only after every case transaction sharing that bar clock is complete

provenance.selector_policy: only a real-source transition with complete four-timeframe review context may anchor a case
provenance.boundary_policy: simultaneous data-gap and contract-change anomalies produce one observer reset epoch and typed terminal BOS publication

inputs: causal retained histories for reviewability eligibility
pass1.selector_memory: bounded by registered bucket_count times cases_per_bucket
pass1.output: create-once exact selection authority with real-row provenance and prefix commitments
pass1.completion: all 120 registered buckets contain exactly two materializable cases; otherwise unavailable and Pass2 is forbidden

pass2.replay: one fresh chronological reader/observer replay; all selected cases sharing a clock are committed before the next receipt
pass2.transaction: authority and blind roots are fsynced under one staging case directory, committed by exact COMPLETED.json hashes, then atomically renamed
pass2.reviewer_export: requires the original physically bound packets root and an explicit outside destination; it rewrites deterministic internal identities to cryptographically random reviewer identities, creates unit directories only in random-identity order rather than event order, leaves the mapping only in the engine root and copies no semantic_event_id, case-completion commitment or authority data

review_and_truth.global_lock: requires exactly 240 unique, semantically valid review transactions and derives the count from the frozen selection dimensions
review_and_truth.truth: revalidates all 240 actual review documents, exact selection/Pass2 identities, authority commitment and complete categorical visual marker map before reveal
review_and_truth.scorecard: requires exactly 240 immutable truth overlays and computes the 216/240 strict agreement gate

checkpoint.format: content-addressed trusted-local pickle behind a hash-bound JSON manifest
checkpoint.progress: durable checkpoint state only; percentage and ETA never include uncommitted in-memory work

release_gate: new independent static approval, full-size synthetic confirmatory pass and separate data release are required before real Pass1
